more_info.overview: Guar gum is used as an emulsifier in food. Its technological role is to help oil and water remain mixed.
more_info.uses: EU permissions include milk-based drinks and similar products intended for young children, unflavoured live fermented cream products and substitute products, both with a fat  content of less than 20 %, canned or bottled fruit and vegetables, jam jellies and marmalades and similar products. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
more_info.origin: Made from the ground endosperm of guar seeds. Further controlled processing can adjust the gum viscosity.
more_info.dietary_restrictions: The specified starting material is plant derived and compatible with vegetarian and vegan diets. The specification does not establish halal or kosher certification.
